beats.narration: This is how PoPo dot meme uses Envio HyperIndex on Monad testnet, chain id ten fourteen three. Every meme coin and every prediction-market trade is indexed in real time into a typed GraphQL API, ready for analytics and frontends.

It starts with a declarative config. One EIP twenty-five thirty-five Diamond hosts both our Hatch bonding-curve facets and the prediction-market facet, so the two indexer entries point at the same address but subscribe to different event signatures.

The GraphQL schema defines typed entities such as Trader, Memecoin, HatchTrade and PredictionTrade. TypeScript event handlers decode each event, keep all dollar-P amounts as raw eighteen-decimal big integers, and write a row that is immediately queryable.

The live dashboard reads straight from the Hasura GraphQL endpoint. Right now it has indexed sixty-one meme coins, twenty-four traders, seven hundred and four hatch trades, and seven prediction markets.

Here are the latest PredictionTrade rows, newest block first. The highlighted row is the exact transaction our MetaMask Agent Wallet plugin signed and broadcast, proving one on-chain action lands in both the trader CLI and the indexed backend. This is the raw GraphQL response, no mock data.
With Envio HyperIndex, PoPo dot meme turns raw Diamond events into a real-time, composable GraphQL API. Thank you.
